I understand that the ancient Nopon
possessed advanced knowledge, but...

rows.label: tlk4537015301_msg0002
rows.name:
But looking at the Nopon of today,
it is hard to imagine them leaving
behind artifacts of this nature.

rows.label: tlk4537015301_msg0003
rows.name:
What could have happened to
change the Nopon race so in
the intervening years...?
